newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper prices rise, aluminium ends steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper prices rise, aluminium ends steady.

text.p: Copper prices climbed but lead weakened on Monday, dealers said.
Other base metals were quiet amid narrow trading range.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,800 rupees per quintal on fresh physical support. Copper was down by 50 rupees on Saturday but was up by 300 rupees per quintal during last week.

Prices lifted today on reports of price hikes announced by the state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd for December, dealers said. They said Hindustan Copper has hiked selling prices of copper wire bars by 12,000 rupees to 112,000 rupees per tonne.
Hindustan Zinc has lowered selling prices of lead by 1,000 rupees per tonne but kept unchanged prices of zinc, said Sharad Parikh, president of Bombay Bullion Exchange.
Tin was steady at the improved level of 34,900 rupees per quintal and nickel at 37,100 rupees on stray physical support.
Aluminium was steady today at 7,300 rupees per quintal.
